notes.title: Fix for Linux and Mac users
notes.content:
If you had tried installing the game on Linux or Mac, you may have received an error along the lines of "missing executable".

The problem were some simple settings in Steam that I got wrong. 
All fixed now!

What you'll want to do now is to delete the local Steam files and download again. Then it will work.

Really sorry about that,  thanks for being patient everyone.

notes.title: Birdsketball 0.9 update - Collaborative level editor
notes.content:
[h1]Make levels[/h1]
Now you can make and edit levels from within the game. It's actually really fun. You can access this from the bottom of the VS mode level select screen.

Here's a little timelapse of Anita and I testing it out:
https://youtu.be/UZYwZpTAVFo

[h1]No more slowdown[/h1]
I noticed some Birdsketball videos on Youtube that were running really slowly. 
This was because the game was trying to render every frame, so when the framerate dropped below 60 the game would go into slow motion.

I've changed the game to run with a variable time step, which should maintain a consistent speed across all computers.
